name: get_snp
description: GWAS Catalog: look up a single-nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) by rsID. Returns functional class, chromosome/region locations, and mapped genes (with up/downstream + distance). Keyless, from EBI/NHGRI.

name: snp_associations
description: GWAS Catalog: get trait/disease associations for a SNP (rsID) — risk allele, p-value, odds ratio per copy, beta/effect size, and risk allele frequency. Keyless, from EBI/NHGRI.

name: studies_by_trait
description: GWAS Catalog: find genome-wide association studies for a disease/trait (EFO trait, e.g. "asthma" or "type 2 diabetes"). Returns accession, PubMed ID, title, journal, date, sample size. Keyless, from EBI/NHGRI.

trait.description: Disease or trait name, e.g. "asthma", "type 2 diabetes".
